Hill-number profile per dataset across orders 0 to 3

Source: R/plot-portrait.R
vt_plot_hill_profile.Rd

For every dataset, computes the compilation-wide Hill number for q in the sequence seq(0, 3, by = 0.25) averaged across years and sites, and plots one line per dataset coloured by taxonomic_focus. Hill profiles characterise the diversity-of-order continuum: q=0 is richness, q=1 is exp(Shannon), q=2 is inverse Simpson, large q saturates to dominance reciprocal.

Usage

vt_plot_hill_profile(x)

Arguments

x

A vt_compilation.

Value

A ggplot.

References

Hill (1973); Chao et al. (2014).

See also

vt_alpha_diversity(), vt_plot_alpha_hist()

Examples

if (FALSE)  data(vertetime); vt_plot_hill_profile(vertetime)  # \dontrun{}
